How much cheaper is the other option on this sale?

The other option, [Higher deductible, lower premium](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aZgoCAE/view), costs **$125 a year less** than this one ($1,435 vs $1,560, about 8%). To get that saving the customer takes a **$2,000 deductible** instead of $1,000. The coverage limit is $100,000 on both.

| Option | Premium | Deductible |
|---|---|---|
| Standard deductible (this one) | $1,560 | $1,000 |
| [Higher deductible](/lightning/r/0Q0aj000003aZgoCAE/view) | **$1,435** | **$2,000** |

Both quotes have been presented and are waiting on the customer. This quote is valid until 16 Oct.
